blocks.text: Ten days across three countries: the Carnival’s grand finale in Rio de Janeiro, the Parade of Champions, with Sugar Loaf and Christ the Redeemer; the Iguazu Falls from both the Brazilian and Argentine sides; Buenos Aires and its tango; and Santiago de Chile at the foot of the Andes, with an optional visit to the wineries of the Maipo Valley.
